rules.title: Registered CSS tokens
rules.source: Prototype governance proposal, grounded in observed widget CSS
rules.limitations: PostCSS AST and value AST; literal palette colors and undeclared var references; transparent/currentColor/inherit remain allowed semantic keywords. Does not cover JS inline styles, CSS-in-JS, dynamic CSS, HTML attributes, external CSS, or semantic misuse of valid tokens. Token authority requires protected review.

rules.title: Approved interactive primitives
rules.scope: TS/JSX under src/app, src/pages, src/features, src/components/patterns and src/components/features
rules.limitations: TypeScript AST and symbols check intrinsic button/input/select/textarea and lexically resolved const aliases to those string tags. Does not cover dynamic aliases, React.createElement, custom wrapper implementations, or library provenance. UI directory is privileged and requires protected review.

rules.title: One visible page heading
rules.source: Product-layer proposal and live files heading observation
rules.scope: Files, connectors, agents, guidelines desktop and mobile main landmark
rules.limitations: Explicit routes only; does not discover unknown routes or all state transitions.

rules.title: Controls retain accessible names
rules.scope: Interactive controls on tested initial routes at 1280px and 390px
rules.limitations: Not full WCAG audit; keyboard interaction, screen readers and new dynamic states still need review.

rules.title: Empty states provide working recovery
rules.scope: Connector empty state and file search empty state
rules.limitations: Tests known recovery flows only; network error/loading/permission states require separate fixtures.

rules.title: Guidance names an existing destination
rules.source: Observed mismatch between available and connectable tab names
rules.scope: Connector recovery guidance, actual tab accessible name and destination
rules.limitations: Checks a canonical English destination contract ("Connectable", obsolete synonym "Available"); further translations and renamed copy require reviewed test changes.

rules.title: Responsive file fields keep labels and geometry
rules.source: Observed file table mobile header misalignment
rules.scope: 320px, 390px, 800px and 1280px files list; independent known-file label/value oracle, header and metadata labels, document overflow, item bounds
rules.limitations: Geometric assertions and captured screenshots are not pixel equivalence; long text, other locales and all browser engines remain manual review.

rules.title: Executable documentation and time-bounded exceptions
rules.scope: Rule schema, required IDs and check paths, design.md local links and mandatory links, exact-file exceptions
rules.limitations: Format and expiry validation cannot authenticate approvers or prevent edited checks. Protected CI, CODEOWNERS and branch policy are external prerequisites. Browser exceptions are unsupported and fail closed.

rules.title: Axe checks on explicit interaction states
rules.source: Prototype verification enhancement, not an official CREAO requirement
rules.scope: Eight states at 1280x900 and 390x844: Files initial/empty search/folder validation error/preview; Connectors connected empty; Agents empty/detail; Guidelines. 16 full-page scans.
rules.limitations: Axe tags wcag2a/wcag2aa/wcag21a/wcag21aa; any violation fails. No rule disable/exclusion. Incomplete findings are retained for manual review. Automated scans do not establish WCAG conformance, keyboard usability, all routes, all states, or all viewport coverage.

rules.title: Reviewed environment-specific visual baselines
rules.scope: Three full-page screenshots: Files initial list at 1280x900 and 390x900; Connectors connected empty at 1280x900. maxDiffPixels=0, threshold=0.2.
rules.limitations: Baseline namespace includes OS, architecture, release, and browser version. Missing/mismatched baselines fail closed. Linux requires its own reviewed baseline; never skip or auto-accept. Legitimate UI changes can fail and require screenshot review. Does not detect all usability problems or cover unrepresented states.

rules.title: Tabs are single-select view switches
rules.source: Component consistency proposal in exam/design-system-guideline.md (Tabs vs FilterChips)
rules.scope: Main landmark of files, connectors, agents, guidelines at 1280px and 390px initial state; connectors must render exactly one tablist
rules.limitations: Asserts role=tablist count (connectors exactly one, others at most one), aria-selected on every tab, exactly one selected tab before and after one tab click. Does not check FilterChips grouping, search/tabs/chips/count DOM order, visual style parity, or routes/states outside the explicit fixtures.

rules.title: At most one filled primary action per main region
rules.source: Component consistency proposal in exam/design-system-guideline.md (action hierarchy)
rules.scope: Main landmark of files, connectors, agents, guidelines at 1280px and 390px initial state
rules.limitations: Primary is detected by the Button primitive's button-primary class; a styled lookalike or a primary outside main is not counted. Main landmark only, not sub-regions or dialogs outside main. Initial route state only: the files create-folder form and agents detail state each render one primary but are not exercised. Secondary/tertiary hierarchy and IconButton variant consistency remain review items.

rules.title: Page header anatomy is consistent across routes
rules.scope: Main h1 of files, connectors, agents, guidelines at 1280px and 390px initial state
rules.limitations: Compares computed font-family, font-size and font-weight of the main h1 only. Does not check spacing, subtitle/description, header actions, color, line-height, or states other than the initial route render.

rules.title: Collection copy matches document locale
rules.scope: Main landmark of connectors and files at 1280px and 390px initial state
rules.limitations: Asserts document lang starts with en and no visible CJK (U+3400-U+9FFF) text in main unless inside an element with data-source-lang. Does not detect other non-English scripts, Latin-script non-English copy, text outside main, attributes (aria-label, title, placeholder), or other routes/states.
